items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: I went with Celestan's band... Holloway was on the trumpet.

ctx.x: How long did you stay with that?

Well, we stayed with Mamet about six or seven months. And the band broke up and came on back home. And then I went with Celestan's band. I stayed on the road with Celestan's band about a year. Who did Celestan live then? Well, Bill Matthews was on the trombone. John Poodle was on the bass. Anderson, uh, Anderson's, what's his name? Andy Anderson. Andy Anderson playing trumpet. Holloway was on the trumpet. And, uh, we had that boy from Tuy. From what? I think he's from around, uh, around the home or somewhere.…
